welcomeEmail:
Hi {{firstname}},

We are very happy to welcome new users and to do so, we are available for any questions or information you may need about the application.

Liveshopp is the app that brings together the fashion community live and allows you to interact directly with your favorite seller and make great deals by buying the item you fell in love with in one click 😍

To get started on Liveshopp and start bidding on items during lives, don't forget to provide:

👍 : Your delivery address, which will be useful for the seller to send you the items

✌️ : A payment method, which will allow you to buy live.

There you go! Enjoy your lives {{firstname}} 🔥 !

Sofiane, founder at Liveshopp
auctionNotification:
Hi {{company_name}},

We wanted to inform you that as of today, no bids have been placed on your item {{product_name}}. However, we are pleased to see that your item has generated some interest.

We encourage you to re-list the item for auction, possibly with a slightly lower starting price. We would be happy to assist you throughout this process.

If you have any questions or need further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. We are here to help you at every step of the sale.

Liveshopp Team

auctionEndNotification:
Hi {{company_name}},

We wanted to inform you that the auction for your item {{product_name}} recently ended, but unfortunately, no bidder met the reserve price you set.


Despite this, we see that your item generated a lot of interest.

If you wish, we encourage you to re-list the item for auction with an adjusted reserve price. We would be happy to assist you throughout this process.

The Liveshopp Team

bidConfirmation:
Hi {{firstname}},

Your current bid of {{current_price}} € for the item {{product_name}} has been recorded and will be considered at the close of the auction, subject to the following conditions:

1. It equals or exceeds the reserve price set by the seller.
2. No higher bid is submitted during the auction period.
3. Your payment method is valid.

If your bid meets these criteria, you won't need to do anything! The amount of your bid will be automatically charged, and you will receive a confirmation email.

Thank you for your trust. For any additional questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

The Liveshopp Team
